title: Code-Review-Graph: Cut AI Code Review Tokens by 80x
description:
Code-review-graph is a free, local-first tool that builds a map of your codebase so AI coding assistants only read the files that matter during reviews. It cuts tokens by around 80 times, updates incrementally in under 2 seconds, and works with Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and more. Install with one pip command.
